subject: School Name Review Committee Assignments
overview: The meeting was held to randomly assign committee members to specific school name proposals and review categories for research purposes.

items.title: Random Selection Process
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Peter Cushing utilized a random number generator to assign numbered committee members to a list of school name proposals on a spreadsheet.

items.title: Correction of Spreadsheet Entries
items.summary: The committee corrected manual entry errors and split a combined line for the Sagamore John and Pawtucket schools to ensure each received a separate assignment sequence.
